metadata: Nejc Geržinič; Oded Cats; Niels van Oort; Sascha Hoogendoorn-Lanser; Michel Bierlaire; Serge Hoogendoorn. An instance-based learning approach for evaluating the perception of ride-hailing waiting time variability. Travel Behaviour and Society 33:100616 (2023). DOI 10.1016/j.tbs.2023.100616.
notes: Official TU Delft journal record independently opened and confirms all metadata in old bibliography; no correction needed. Official arXiv preprint page also opened and links the published DOI. Do not replace final-journal reference with arXiv merely because Elsevier redirect and repository PDF fetching failed. Abstract concerns waiting-time variability (936 stated-preference responses), not a verified20–25EUR/hour valuation claim; the latter remains unverified.
